sourceDocuments.title: Structural Properties of High-Tc Superconductors
sourceDocuments.text: Crystallographic analysis reveals that high-temperature superconducting cuprates possess a layered perovskite structure with alternating copper-oxide planes.

studentDocument.title: Political Structures of Ancient Rome
studentDocument.text: The constitutional history of the Roman Republic illustrates the delicate balance of power between aristocratic senatorial bodies and popular tribunes. Plebeian assemblies exercised legislative power while consular magistrates led military campaigns abroad.
